   • Create, read, update, delete diagrams directly from your LLM
   • List and browse your Chart projects and diagrams
   • Sync diagrams between local rendering and cloud storage

 RENDERING & VALIDATION: Advanced diagram processing tools:
   • Validate syntax and render diagrams as PNG with editor links
   • AI-powered diagram repair using Mermaid Chart's AI (consumes credits)
   • Support for all Mermaid diagram types with comprehensive validation

 UTILITY TOOLS: Enhanced diagram creation assistance:
